resources.string: Experimental evidence collection for automatic segment detection
Analyze the selected add-on subtitle in the background. Results stay on this device.
AI suggestions require review. At episode end, confirm the boundary images before sending to IntroDB. Automatic publication remains disabled until detection accuracy is validated.
Encrypted on this device, separate for each profile
Enter a key to replace it, or choose Clear to remove it. Saving does not test the key or make any API request.
No evidence collected yet. Enable collection, play an episode and select an add-on subtitle.
Latest analysis: %1$d clues. These are observations, not verified skip times.
Could not load or save settings. Check the key contains no spaces and try again.
Choose automatic submission or image review at the end of the episode
Show start and end images for each detected segment, then approve or skip.
Submit verified segments automatically when the detection engine is connected. Uncertain results are not sent.
These are AI suggestions, not verified skip times. Check the start and end images, adjust times, and include only segments you can confirm.
Submission failed or its outcome is unknown. Completed segments will not be resent in this session. Continue without sending and check IntroDB before retrying.
Image unavailable — waiting for a matching frame
Optional: sends selected captions and sampled video images to Google using your personal key. API charges may apply. Off by default.
